items.distractor_fact: 이웃에 사는 사람은 자기 집 마당의 기온이 {D}도였다고 말했다.
items.gloss_en: A person living next door said the temperature in their own yard was {D} degrees.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — a private individual (a neighbor) reporting from their own yard, not an institution/place (the observatory in another village) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 국내의 한 주식형 펀드는 그날 기준가격이 {D}원으로 마감했다.
items.gloss_en: A domestic equity fund's reference price closed at {D} won that day.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — an organisation (an investment fund), not another individual stock/security as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 인근 하천에 설치된 자동 수위계는 같은 시각 {D}cm를 기록했다.
items.gloss_en: An automatic water-level gauge installed on a nearby stream recorded {D} cm at the same time.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — a measuring instrument (an automatic gauge on a stream), not another place (a nearby reservoir) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 형은 이번 달 자기 통장에서 {D}원을 출금했다.
items.gloss_en: The older brother withdrew {D} won from his own bankbook this month.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — a named individual person (the older brother), not an unspecified separate account as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 사장은 오늘 개인 지갑에 따로 {D}원을 넣어두었다.
items.gloss_en: The owner personally put {D} won into a separate wallet today.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — a specific person (the shop owner) and their personal wallet, not another branch's cash box as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 그가 다니는 동아리 회비 통장에는 이번 달 {D}원이 모였다.
items.gloss_en: The club dues account for a club he belongs to collected {D} won this month.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — an organisation (a club), not another individual person (the roommate) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 그가 계약한 에이전시는 이번 달 지출이 {D}원이었다.
items.gloss_en: The agency he's contracted with had {D} won in expenses this month.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — an organisation (an agency), not another individual freelancer as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 그 팀이 지난 시즌 컵대회에서 기록한 실점은 {D}골이었다.
items.gloss_en: The team's goals conceded in last season's cup competition was {D}.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — a different series/competition (last season's cup tournament, same team), not another team as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 다른 한 펀드는 이번 분기에 손실 {D}원을 기록했다.
items.gloss_en: A different fund recorded a loss of {D} won this quarter.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — an organisation (an investment fund), not another individual investor as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: 지난달 열린 다른 대회에서는 우승자의 타수가 {D}타였다.
items.gloss_en: In a different tournament held last month, the winner's score was {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — a different series (a separate tournament held last month), not another golfer on another course as the first distractor used; that tournament's own par is unstated so no second par-based subtraction is implied

items.distractor_fact: 이 대회를 주최하는 클럽이 매년 여는 사내 친선전에서는 한 회원이 {D}타를 쳤다.
items.gloss_en: In the annual in-house friendly event held by the club that hosts this tournament, a member shot {D} strokes.
items.entity_note: different kind of owner — an organisation (the hosting club's own separate event), not another individual golfer as the first distractor used; that event's par is unstated so no second par-based subtraction is implied
